title: Distributed Backtester Worker Ready
description: Worker-to-coordinator availability announcement. The worker sends this once after the transport is connected and before it waits for work. No reply is defined.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this schema, for editor support.

protocol_version.description: Wire protocol version. Only version 1 is supported.

message_id.description: Correlation key for logs and diagnostics.

worker_id.description: Identity of the worker that owns this connection.
